15.t: Working with data: the alkane series
q: State the boiling point of propane (3 carbons).
Methane, ethane, propane, butane (1-4 carbons): their boiling points are below 25 °C.
Estimate the boiling point of heptane (7 carbons) from the graph.
Explain the trend in terms of forces between molecules.
Longer molecules have stronger forces between molecules (more contact), so more energy is needed to separate them: boiling point rises, though each step adds less.
